title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: 2-byte complete ACK window extracted from wrong bit position
description: In the 2-byte complete ACK fix at fragment.rs:264-269, the window bit is extracted from bit 6 via (data[1] >> FRAGMENT_N) & 1 where FRAGMENT_N=6. However, write_to encodes the 2-byte complete ACK with window at bit 7: (self.window << 7) | 0x40. This means (data[1] >> 6) & 1 will always yield 1 for 2-byte complete ACKs (since bit 6=0x40 is always set), regardless of actual window value. Fix: move window extraction into the 2-byte branch using (data[1] >> 7) & 1, or restructure so the shared extraction applies only to bitmap ACKs.
